name: sekkei
description: Sekkei - Section Planner & Workflow Toolkit for Elementor

scripts.build:js: npx -y terser assets/js/itspc-tool.js -o assets/js/itspc-tool.min.js --compress --mangle --source-map && npx -y terser assets/js/itspc-editor.js -o assets/js/itspc-editor.min.js --compress --mangle --source-map && npx -y terser assets/js/itspc-admin.js -o assets/js/itspc-admin.min.js --compress --mangle --source-map
scripts.build:css: npx -y cssnano-cli assets/css/itspc-tool.css assets/css/itspc-tool.min.css && npx -y cssnano-cli assets/css/itspc-admin.css assets/css/itspc-admin.min.css && npx -y cssnano-cli assets/css/itspc-editor.css assets/css/itspc-editor.min.css && npx -y cssnano-cli assets/css/itspc-tool-page.css assets/css/itspc-tool-page.min.css
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
